messages.subject: TravisCI problem with psData
parts:
Hi Christopher,

As noticed, psData introduces xlsx as dependency, which brings in JDK as a dependency, leading to problems with TravisCI.

@jlehtoma suggested that setting up JAVA_LD_LIBRARY_PATH correctly could fix this (configuring Java on TravisCI); to fix TravisCI test build, you could try to modify https://github.com/rOpenGov/ropengov.github.io/blob/site-development/.travis.yml lines 9-10 (not sure if needed) and 19. Create your own branch to test this, and if you get it working perhaps you could send a pull request?

Not sure how soon I will have time to look at this myself, so at least wanted to write down what might help to solve it. This only concerns the psData package so far, so if you have a chance to have a look that would be great. But let us know if you need further support.
 
Leo
